correctness.rationale: The inverse suffix transform is x_i=s_i+t_i−t_(i+1), x_n=t_n. In the t-cube this removes exactly the redundant side of each coordinate bound and leaves a single comparison across each edge. Ball containment is therefore equivalent to shifting the suffix halfspaces by r√(n−i+1) and the retained comparisons by r, since those are the normal lengths in x, not in t. Summing along any directed path i→j gives the obstruction r(a_i+a_j+d)≤1. A one-edge extension of a path strictly increases this denominator because adjacent weights differ by less than 1; the first-edge denominator even exceeds every zero-edge denominator. Conversely, the maximum of a_j+d over all downstream paths from i gives a potential L_i with L_i≥L_j+1 on edges and a_i≤L_i≤H−a_i. The center t_i=L_i/H thus attains the bound; the exact shifted halfspaces describe all centers, and telescoping equality forces all contacts on maximizing paths. The upper denominator n+√n is attained only by a full directed path; alternating words attain the smallest denominator. Reversal followed by complement in t preserves the reversed edge word and has an integer affine unimodular inverse. For S={1} the length-(n−2) run dominates the first edge for n≥4, with a tie at n=4; for S′={n−1} the longer run dominates strictly. Their denominators differ by √2−1+√n−√(n−1)>0. The n=1 segment and n=2 single edge agree with their separate stated cases. The supplied LP checker was inspected, not run; the analytic argument establishes the universal statement.
residual_risks: The all-center description does not classify its dimension or combinatorics; no extension to unlinked intervals is established.

value.rationale: This is an exact original-coordinate invariant for a natural infinite family, not just a difference-constraint algorithm. It replaces Euclidean LPs by a linear scan, pinpoints necessary contacts, and proves both order-n⁻¹ and order-n⁻¹ᐟ² extremal scales in the same family. The explicit reversal family shows what the usual lattice invariants fail to detect.
residual_risks: No claim for arbitrary lattice-path delta matroids or a classification of all extremizers of the upper radius bound.
